user.title: Person Tracker
user.description: Add the cameras to watch. A camera must be assigned to an HA area and needs at least one trigger binary sensor. People are added afterwards from the integration page.

data_description.snapshot_source: Where the picture for identification comes from. Camera snapshot uses the camera's still image. Video stream grabs one full-resolution frame from the camera's stream; use it when the still image is low resolution (UniFi Protect 2K cameras deliver 640 x 360 stills). It takes 1-2 seconds longer per detection, and falls back to the still image if the stream fails.
data_description.snapshot_size: Experimental. Downscale the picture before identification so its shorter edge is at most 1080 or 960 px (e.g. 2688 x 1512 becomes 1920 x 1080 or 1707 x 960). Smaller pictures make each AI request cheaper and faster but show less detail. Smaller pictures are never enlarged.

ai_task.title: AI task
ai_task.description: Select the AI task entity used to identify people on camera snapshots, and how it is asked. It must support image attachments.

data_description.ai_method: Generate data asks the AI for structured output with confidences and boxes around each person (cropped last-seen pictures). Evaluate (Home Assistant 2026.11+) asks your decision model one yes/no question per person and uses its probabilities as confidences; it gives no boxes, so last-seen pictures show the full frame. The entity must support Evaluate.

detection.title: Detection settings
detection.description: How long to wait between detection runs on the same camera, and how confident the AI must be before a person is considered identified.

data.move_check: Move check after a supporting tracker move
data.handoff_check: Handoff check when a camera loses sight

data_description.min_confidence: Identifications below this confidence (0-1) update no tracker; the snapshot is kept as an unknown snapshot instead. Raise it if people get mixed up.
data_description.recheck: Shortly before a person's sighting expires, take one more snapshot from the camera that last saw them and ask the AI whether they are still there. Keeps people who sit still (and so trigger no new detection) at home, at the cost of one AI call per expiry.
data_description.move_check: When a person's supporting tracker settles in another area that has cameras, and no camera has seen them there yet, ask that area's cameras whether the person is there. A confirmation counts as a normal camera sighting. Costs at most one AI call per camera of that area per move; only affects people with a supporting area entity.
data_description.handoff_check: When a camera's detection turns off, ask every other camera whose detection is still on whether the people that camera last saw are there now. Catches someone walking into a room that is already occupied, where no new detection fires. A confirmation counts as a normal camera sighting. Costs at most one AI call per active camera each time a camera loses sight of someone.

error.invalid_camera: The camera must be an existing camera entity.
error.duplicate_camera: This camera is already in the map.

error.no_cameras: At least one camera must remain.
error.no_triggers: This camera needs at least one trigger binary sensor.
error.invalid_trigger: One or more triggers are not binary_sensor entities.
error.invalid_ai_task_entity: The AI task entity must be an existing AI task entity.
error.evaluate_unavailable: The evaluate method needs Home Assistant 2026.11 or newer.
error.evaluate_not_supported: This AI task entity does not support Evaluate; pick another entity or the generate data method.

abort.no_ai_task_entity: No AI task entity is available. Set up an AI provider integration that offers AI tasks (e.g. OpenAI, Google Gemini, Ollama) first.

user.title: Add person
user.description: Reference images go in a folder named after the person inside {people_dir}.

data_description.description: Distinguishing features, e.g. height, build, hair, glasses, beard. Sent to the AI to help tell household members apart when the face is not visible.
data_description.supporting_area_entity: A lower-priority, room-level location source, e.g. a BLE tracker's area sensor. Its state names an area (ID, name or alias).
data_description.supporting_floor_entity: Its state names a floor (ID, name or alias). Without it, the floor of the supporting area is used.

reconfigure.title: Edit person
reconfigure.description: This person's reference images are in {images_dir}. Renaming the person also renames that folder; move the images accordingly.

error.invalid_person_name: Invalid person name. Names must not be empty, may not contain whitespace or path characters, and are used as folder names.
error.invalid_authoritative_tracker: The authoritative tracker must be an existing device_tracker entity.
error.invalid_supporting_entity: The supporting tracker entity must be an existing entity.
